evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: The typical workflow for improving large-scale ranking and recommendation models is slow and tedious: an engineer forms a hypothesis, implements it as a code change, trains a model, and evaluates it both offline and online, often relying on their own intuition and experience along the way.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We identify three obstacles that make this industry setting challenging: feedback takes hours per experiment, offline metrics do not always predict online impact, and improvements saturate after the early wins.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: In one campaign, the system ran 1,097 completed candidate experiments and accepted 325, a 29.6\% acceptance rate compared with 15.6\% in the earlier campaign under a different objective and search constraint.
